title: Banks Act Directive D9/2025 — Prudential treatment of credit exposures secured by forest and agricultural land
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Prudential treatment of credit exposures secured by forest and agricultural land.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Prudential treatment of credit exposures secured by forest and agricultural land.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Prudential treatment of credit exposures secured by forest and agricultural land. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
